## Change and motivation

Describe the user-visible problem and the focused change.

## Verification

List checks run, results, and any interactive terminal checks. Explain compatibility risks and untested cases.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] Spanish and English text remain aligned; usage documentation matches behavior.
- [ ] Help still does not send messages, call a model, execute processes, use the network, or persist session state.
- [ ] Draft replacement requires confirmation and preserves concurrent edits.
- [ ] UI changes were checked with keyboard navigation and a narrow terminal, or the limitation is stated.
- [ ] No credentials, real drafts, prompts, session logs, personal paths, or private configuration are included.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute the included material under MIT.

For vulnerabilities, use the private reporting channel in SECURITY.md instead of disclosing them here.
